meta.title: EPLAN drawing automation
meta.description: Creates pages, places symbols, draws connections and validates them in EPLAN Electric P8: run_code is the only direct tool, and the 12 mcp__eplan__* tools are called from inside a program. A screen recording pasted into the chat is split into stages with full-page frames. Requires Windows, a local EPLAN Electric P8 2.9 install with Remoting enabled, and one run of node setup.mjs.
